direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge sub-11px SVG labels for jobs, evidence IDs and option cards to 11px minimum and refit the lower stage row so all text clears the legend at 1366x768.
Reduce the inspector evidence list internal scroll length by tightening card padding, while keeping the opening-story logo placement and the 70 / 2 / 36h metrics visible.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the Inspect source evidence disclosure and link SVG RECEIVING selection to the matching evidence card in both directions.
Keep Route health pre-flight for nonce and identity as its own bordered region above, and Investigation source evidence as a distinct task below, with independent status text and controls.
Enlarge the route select and Run Sample investigation targets to at least 40px high and ensure the select shows the full offline label without truncation.
Trim the bottom inspector explanation to one status sentence so the primary action remains visible without inspector compression.
Preserve that selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form directly beneath it; keep the exact phrase, character count and disabled Accept state grouped as one labelled form.
Widen the selected path row treatment beyond color alone by adding Selected path text and a marker, matching the stage option highlight.
Enlarge the plan identifier line to 11px and allow it to wrap inside the Human decision panel instead of crowding the phrase instruction.
Make the untracked-until-approval proposal state unmistakable on each of the 3 task tabs, not only in the panel header, while keeping Approve as the single action-bar primary.
Enlarge task tab targets and show task title plus due detail on the selected tab summary so users need not rely on the small numbered squares alone.
Remove the nested scroll impression in the inspector by giving the proposal list one clear internal scroll region with a visible end marker.
Distinguish preview from applied state: keep CELL-MILL-2 in silver with PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE text and hatch until Apply second shock is activated, reserving red for the applied stopped state.
Enlarge the machine select to 40px and add a focus ring that remains visible against the dark panel.
Move the invalidation consequence directly beside the select and repeat it once only in the action-bar centre status.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 exclusively in stoppedRed outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED label, with no feasible route drawn through it and feasible paths only through CELL-MILL-1.
Retain separate pre-flight nonce/identity health and distinct investigation evidence regions, and enlarge their status lines to 11px minimum.
Strengthen the 3 to 2 feasible paths banner by placing it adjacent to the constrained Split option state in the stage.
Keep the typed consent form opening on selection, with Scenario changed review required, exact phrase and disabled Accept revised decision visibly linked to the selected feasible path.
Give the constrained Split card pattern plus text and dashed finish values so infeasibility is not carried by color or strikethrough alone.
Enlarge the prior-acceptance-invalidated centre status and ensure it does not compete with the inspector heading hierarchy.
Separate the 3 BLOCKED prior tasks list from the 3 PROPOSED replacement tasks with two labelled, independently scrollable regions so both remain visible beside the approved revised plan.
Fix inspector clipping: enlarge the panel, reduce nested borders and ensure Review proposed tasks and Decline proposal stay fully inside the viewport.
Add pattern and text markers to blocked versus proposed tasks and keep replacement tasks explicitly untracked until Approve revised tasks is activated.
Sequence Verify ledger, separate passphrase, seal packet and retain checkpoint as numbered locked steps, with each disabled control explaining its prerequisite in text.
Enlarge the passphrase field label and checklist type to 11px minimum and give the input a clear neon focus ring without revealing entry state.
Compress the Before to After metrics row so the full evidence sequence fits the inspector at 1366x768 without pushing step 3 below the fold.

Replace the duplicated Verify ledger control on the completed state with a disabled Complete current ledger status, retaining Export independent checkpoint only if its shown complete state is accurate to supplied state.
Make the sealed centre status the sole completion announcement and add aria-live polite wording matching PACKET SEALED, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained.
Enlarge rail completion check and Proof label targets while preserving red only on stopped CELL-MILL-2 and no additional logo placement.
